Stuck Inside Of Mobile With The Memphis Blues Again

first_in_archive: Take A Step Back / Mexican Hat Dance Tuning

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Iko Iko** (3 reviews): Iko Iko into Jack Straw made a great opening, heard from behind the sound engineer's tent; Opens with a fun Iko [16][17][22]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Good-natured Sugaree, with Jerry roaming all over the place late in the song [22]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat into I Know You Rider got the whole stands going mid-show [16]
- **I'll Be Your Baby Tonight** (1 other source): Garcia played pedal steel on I'll Be Your Baby Tonight [1]
- Dylan's voice was croaking during his set [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **Take A Step Back / Mexican Hat Dance Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **Tangled Up In Blue**: rare: 3 archived performances [27]
- **I'll Be Your Baby Tonight**: rare: 5 archived performances [27]
- **Man Of Peace**: rare: 5 archived performances [27]
- **The Ballad Of Frankie Lee And Judas Priest**: rare: 4 archived performances [27]
- **John Brown**: rare: 5 archived performances [27]
- **Simple Twist Of Fate**: rare: 4 archived performances [27]
- **Ballad Of A Thin Man**: rare: 10 archived performances [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-07-10.135276.mtx.tobin.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 33 songs; 209 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1987-07-10.149955.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 33 songs; 211 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1987-07-10.aud.carpenter.87266.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 33 songs; 203 min [7]. Said about its sound: Levels rise gradually in Iko; Terrapin and Stuck Inside Mobile begin abruptly; minor mic bumps throughout [7]
- **gd87-07-10.senn.lai.3859.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 31 songs; 200 min; rated 3.91/5 by 32 [8]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds poor and is hard to listen to, weak next to top-quality archive recordings; Reviewer says the recording's sound is disappointing [20][21]

## Around the show

- Banter between songs, plus a messy false start involving Dylan that fell apart on stage [15]
- Crowd of roughly 110,000 in a packed stadium; show began late afternoon, and bikers cheered around the listener [16]
- Dylan reportedly nearly retired early in rehearsals with the Dead, who helped revive his energy [17]
- Stadium big screen projections showed audience members before the band came on; reviewer's date appeared on screen [18]
- Heat on the floor was so severe people passed out; hoses doused the crowd [20]
- Great parking lot scene at JFK; reviewer drove from the Jersey Shore, and a toll gate slammed on the van [21]
- Field temperature was around 105 to 110 degrees; bleachers were rumored to be fiberglass [24]
- Utter mayhem in the crowd, likened to being an extra on a Mad Max film set [26]
- Dylan set includes songs that are absent from the Dylan and the Dead CD [17]
- Band seemed less energetic than at Roanoke, perhaps due to heat; this Jack falls short of the Alpine set-closer [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-07-10.135276.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=101651) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> FLAC; All… [1]
- **gd1987-07-10.149955.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 6, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [2]. Also: Soundboard matrix recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; multiple master sets were combined to complete the show [2]
- **gd1987-07-10.aud.carpenter.87266.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ted Carpenter; transferred by Andrew F; source: Nakamichi CM-700's > patched from one Sony D5 > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's (no Dolby), set up FOB [7]. Also: Audience source patched with crowd-noise fixes from another copy; fades and levels adjusted in Soundforge, converted to FLAC [7]
- **gd87-07-10.senn.lai.3859.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB> aud> senn me80> cassette master> cdr [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1987-07-10 John F Kennedy Stadium, Philadelphia, PA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-07-10-john-f-kennedy-stadium-philadelphia-pa-usa/) [28]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead JFK Stadium 7/10/87](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/jfk-stadium-7-10-87) [29]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead John F. Kennedy Stadium - July 10, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/july-10-1987) [30]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1987-07-10 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1987-07-10-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [31]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead John F. Kennedy Stadium - July 10, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/july-10-1987) [32]
- Poster by www.obatik.com: [Bob Dylan with The Grateful Dead – Men Of Peace – Jerry Scott](https://www.obatik.com/album/collections/songs/music-log/august-2011-albums/bob-dylan-with-the-grateful-dead-men-of-peace/) [33]
